India Kabaddi Teams Reach Asian Games Semifinals Unbeaten

The Indian men's and women's kabaddi teams have advanced to the semifinals of the Asian Games. Both teams secured their spots by winning their respective matches, with the women's team defeating Japan and entering the semifinals unbeaten. The men's team also achieved dominant wins to reach the semifinals.
